sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong backward-looking results (revenue beat, net income nearly doubled) but the market reaction was sharply negative, with shares falling nearly 10% due to 'investor concerns around forward trajectory rather than past execution.' Although full-year free cash flow guidance was raised, the document does not state that revenue or earnings guidance was raised; instead, it mentions 'weak guidance shook investor confidence.' The negative market reaction and explicit forward-looking concerns outweigh the positive backward-looking beat and FCF guidance raise, resulting in a mildly bearish score.
